high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Kunal Kushwaha, a Twitter user with the handle @kunalswt. The tweet is set against a black background with white text, making it highly readable. The tweet is accompanied by a profile picture of Kunal Kushwaha, who appears to be a young man with short hair. The content of the tweet discusses the severe air pollution in Delhi and advises residents to leave the city if necessary. Kunal shares his personal experience growing up in Delhi and studying there, where he did not feel the impact of poor air quality as drastically as he does now.
